name: Training Losses for Implicit Surface Learning
definition: A set of loss functions used to train the occupancy network fθ and texture network tθ based on 2D image supervision, categorizing pixels into three sets: P0 (inside mask, finite depth), P1 (outside mask), and P2 (inside mask, infinite depth).
summary: Training Losses for Implicit Surface Learning defines loss functions for occupancy and texture networks using 2D image supervision, distinguishing itself by explicitly handling empty space and missing surfaces through targeted penalties.
